name: Isaiah (son of Rehoboam)
title: Levite in charge of the treasures
summary: Isaiah, son of Rehoboam from the line of Moses through Gershom, was one of the Levites responsible for the treasures in the Lord's house during David's time.

keyEvents.title: Levite in charge of temple treasures
keyEvents.description: Isaiah, son of Rehoboam, was among the Levites who had oversight of the treasures in the Lord's house.
